entries.title: A merge card that comes back says what changed
entries.body: When a merge card comes back after you saw an earlier one for the same change, it opens with a short summary of what changed since then. The crewmate writes it in its own words, under a label that says when you saw the earlier card. The pull request never shows it.

picture.alt: A merge card opening with a summary under Since the card you saw, above Why, saying the change grew from 1,366 to 4,562 added lines
